subject: English
question_text: Rearrange the following sentences. Write only the corresponding letters in correct
stimulus: sequences. 1×8= 8 (a) She returned with heavy heart to Buddha and told him the result of her search. (b) One said “I have lost my husband.” The other said, “Our youngest child died last year.” (c) Once a poor woman whose only son recently died came to Buddha. (d) The mother went from door to door and looked for mustard seed but she found one or the other sad reply. (e) Buddah told her that there was only one medicine which could revive her son. (f) Then Buddha told her that she must not think of her own grief since sorrow and death are common to all. (g) She asked him if he could give her any medicine to restore her dead child to life. (h) He again told her to bring a handful of mustard seeds from a house where death had never entered.
guide_solution: The parts of the story can appear in the following order: 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 c g e h d b a f
